text:
This photo shows the meal before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I estimated the served portions and assumed a small amount of leftovers.

Estimated served energy:
- Chicken wrap, cut in two: about 350 kcal
- Sushi, 3 pieces of a futomaki-style roll: about 150 kcal
- Brownie: about 250 kcal
- Latte, mostly milk: about 120 kcal
- Soy sauce and pickled ginger: about 15 kcal

That totals about 885 kcal served. I assumed about 60 kcal would be left over, which gives about 825 kcal eaten.

Estimated macronutrients eaten:
- Protein: about 30 g
- Carbohydrate: about 105 g
- Fat: about 33 g
